# GEO report: quay-store

**New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics.

## Code score: 40/100, At risk

Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points).
How it's calculated: low = 12 ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. High = (12 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. A cap of 40 applies, so the score is 40.

The cap applies because `robots.txt` blocks Googlebot from the whole site. I assumed you want search and AI search tools to find this site, because there is no `geo.config.json`. The uncapped score would be 48. All results are read from code. I sampled 3 routes: `/`, `/shop` and `/search`.

## Live check

**Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL.

## Do these first

### 1. Stop blocking Googlebot
- **Why it matters:** Google's crawler is told to stay off every page, including the home page and shop. The blocking group also overrides the friendlier `*` group for Googlebot.
- **Where:** `static/robots.txt:4-5`
- **What the code says:** `User-agent: Googlebot` followed by `Disallow: /`
- **Size:** Small (delete those two lines)
- **Score after this:** 72/100, Good. This fixes GEO-009 and GEO-014 and removes the cap.

### 2. Render pages on the server
- **Why it matters:** Many crawlers read only the HTML the server first sends. With server rendering off, they see an empty page body.
- **Where:** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1`
- **What the code says:** `export const ssr = false;`
- **Size:** Small (remove it, or set it to `true`)
- **Score after this:** 84/100, Good (cumulative with item 1).

### 3. Set `lang` and fill in descriptions
- **Why it matters:** The `lang` attribute tells machines what language the site is in. Descriptions are the summary that people and machines read first.
- **Where:** `src/app.html:3`, `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3`, `src/routes/search/+page.svelte`
- **What the code says:** `<html>` has no `lang`. `/shop` has `<meta name="description" content="" />`. `/search` has no description.
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** 92/100, Strong (cumulative with items 1 and 2).

## All results

| Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and within size limits | Clear | Not run | `static/robots.txt` is plain text and valid |
| GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access your policy intends | Problem | Not run | `static/robots.txt:4-5`, Googlebot `Disallow: /`. Site-wide, 0 of 3 routes clear |
| GEO-014 | Sitemap-listed and linked routes are indexable | Problem | Not run | `/` and `/shop` are both blocked for Googlebot by `static/robots.txt:5`. 0 of 2 clear. `/search` isn't listed or linked, so it isn't counted |
| GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on the declared origin | Clear | Not run | `src/routes/+page.svelte:4`, `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`. 2 of 2 routes. `/search` is noindex and is skipped |
| GEO-003 | Primary content is in server HTML | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.ts:1`, `ssr = false` on every route |
| GEO-004 | JSON-LD parses and has required properties | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:7`. The `Product` has only `name`, with no `offers`, `review` or `aggregateRating` |
| GEO-011 | Valid sitemap is discoverable | Clear | Not run | `static/sitemap.xml` is valid and `static/robots.txt:7` points to it |
| GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` are present | Problem | Not run | `src/app.html:3` has no `lang` (site-wide). `/shop` has an empty description. `/search` has none |
| GEO-016 | Key routes are reachable through links | Clear | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5` has `<a href>` links to `/` and `/shop` |
| GEO-017 | Snippet limits don't conflict with the policy | Clear | Not run | Only element-level `data-nosnippet` (`src/routes/+layout.svelte:7`). No middleware or headers found |
| GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | Not run | I read the layout and all three pages. There are no images or buttons, and all three have titles |
| GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | Not run | No app is declared |
| GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not applicable | Not run | Not present. It is never scored |

## Other problems found

None found. `/search` is noindex, is not in the sitemap, and is not linked from the navigation, which is consistent.

## Can't tell from code

- **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs <access log>` to check real crawlers against their published addresses.
- **Headers:** I found no `X-Robots-Tag` or other headers set in the repository. Headers added at hosting or CDN level wouldn't show up here.
- **Live status codes:** whether `/robots.txt`, the sitemap URLs and the pages really answer 200. A live scan would confirm this.

## Assumptions

- You want search and AI search tools to find this site, because there is no `geo.config.json`.
- `https://quay.example` is the intended origin. It is used consistently in the canonicals, the sitemap and `robots.txt`.
- You haven't said whether you want to block training crawlers such as GPTBot. `robots.txt` doesn't mention them, and I didn't count that either way.

## What to do next

1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written.
2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more.
3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL.

Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
